name: double-doors-lite
statusMeaning: In the catalogue, not checked yet.
author: kestalkayden
description: This is a lightweight mod which allows doors to open together when next to each other.
evidence: Everything its code calls is covered by Kiln 0.4.5 (19 classes, 31 members). Not run yet.

softOff.why: only events, HUD, keys, commands and guarded mixin handlers

development.name: double-doors-lite
development.statusMeaning: Tried in the game with Kiln.
development.works: Opening one door of a double door opens its neighbour too: the game opens the clicked oak door, the mod the doors beside it that face the same way. With the mod turned off, only the clicked door opens.
development.note: From Modrinth, unchanged. Like the mod, it opens a door on either side and sets their hinges to match.
